referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of a ventilation system for an appartment building with a specific air flow rate of 0.92 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. The reference value of the inventory is 1 m2 heated gross floor area. The inventory is based on a study of an appartment building with 6 flats, a heated gross floor area of 780 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 720 m3/h. The inventory includes an average of decentral and central systems. It includes average components for air handling units, ducts (including 30mm thermal insulation where needed), air valves, roof-hoods, dampers and silencers. No insuation for fire protection or fire dampers included. The data represent a ductwork mainly made of galvanized steel and includes compact air handling units with cross plate heat excangers as heat recovery and a nominal air flow rate of 200-1200 m3/h per unit. No ground heat exchanger, ventilation of side rooms, cellars or car parks are included.; UUID: 62698e20-cc0e-4926-b549-73a47a009d0e
